rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing someone as kind-hearted and good-natured.

example.english: They’re a kindly person who always helps when someone is in trouble.
example.traditional: 佢真係心地好，見到人有難一定會幫手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 sam1 dei6 hou2 gin3 dou2 jan4 jau5 naan4 jat1 ding6 wui5 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a casual description of someone who means well and is willing to help.

example.english: It was kindly of you to watch my bag for me, thanks so much.
example.traditional: 你咁好心幫我睇住個袋，唔該晒。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 hou2 sam1 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 doi6 m4 goi1 saai3

rows.note: Choose this more formal word when emphasizing a morally good or benevolent personality.

example.english: She has always been a kindly person, often donating money to charities.
example.traditional: 佢一直都好善良，成日捐錢畀慈善機構。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 sin6 loeng4 seng4 jat6 gyun1 cin2 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3

rows.note: Use this especially for an older person's gentle, kindly appearance or manner.

example.english: That granny has a very kindly look when she smiles.
example.traditional: 嗰位婆婆笑起上嚟好慈祥。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 po4 po2 siu3 hei2 soeng6 lei4 hou2 ci4 coeng4

rows.note: Use this as the direct, all-purpose way to describe someone doing something out of kindness.

example.english: They kindly helped me move the table.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 sam1 gam2 bong1 ngo5 bun1 zoeng1 toi4

rows.note: Use this casual request marker before an action when kindly means please.

example.english: Could you kindly keep an eye on my seat for me?
example.jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 wai2
